entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Waitaki District Mayor Mel Tavendale says the council will be working with those "inundated by floodwaters" after the region was hit with heavy rain overnight | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

Tavendale was joined by Emergency Management and Recovery Minister Mark Mitchell in Oamaru on Monday. Speaking to reporters, Mitchell said there had been very effective responses to these types of events but there was "no room for complacency".

A number of roads were still closed around the district and are stepping into the recovery mode, Tavendale said. The council was working with the community to try and keep them updated, she said.

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/emergencies_local/677302/weather-live-floods-evacuations-highways-closed-as-deluge-hits-otago-towns
